_note: The HackOS metadata format was not published when this was written. Fields below are a sensible guess: check them against the HackOS submission form and rename or reshape as needed.
tagline: AI agents that find, check and prepare new-parent benefits, refunds and deals, and learn from parent feedback.

sponsor_tech.zetaris: One SQL layer over a private Postgres database (bundle_pg) and live public recall feeds (bundle_live.cpsc_recalls, fda_food_recalls). Every agent reads through it. server/adapters/zetaris.ts, scripts/zetaris/
sponsor_tech.meterless: H-MEM reference memory (vendored, Apache-2.0) stores the rules Bundle learns from parent feedback; the Fine Print Court recalls them. server/adapters/memory.ts, vendor/hmem/
sponsor_tech.nvidia: NVIDIA-hosted models (supported, not exercised in the saved results) through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (MODEL_BASE_URL) write short explanations and judge offers. Without a key, offline fallbacks run. server/adapters/llm.ts
sponsor_tech.built_with: Built with Claude Code. (Cursor was listed as required in the original rules; the organizers announced it optional; confirmation on HackOS is pending.)

pre_existing_components: VibeCode starter template by Colin Matthews (MIT), upstream commit 6af369a, imported in commit b2bc3be
Meterless H-MEM reference implementation (Apache-2.0), vendored in vendor/hmem
